title: Find Branded Foods by description (April 2026)
purpose: Find Branded Foods in this FoodData Central release whose description, brand name or brand owner contains a phrase (case-insensitive; SQL wildcards % and _ keep their meaning), with each food's FDC id, description, brand owner, brand name, GTIN or UPC, branded category and publication date. An exact description match comes first, then shorter descriptions.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Phrase to look for; empty text lists every Branded Food

output_columns.name: fdc_id
output_columns.description: FoodData Central id of the food

output_columns.name: brand_name
output_columns.description: Brand name as published, where given
